title: Partition of unity a posteriori error estimators for the linear elasticity eigenvalue problem
summary: In this paper we consider the linear elasticity eigenvalue problem with different boundary conditions and examine two a posteriori error estimators, that compute solutions to local residual problems using a partition of unity and localized residuals. These a posteriori error estimators are known for the source problem, and in this paper we investigate their reliability and efficiency for the given eigenvalue problem with Dirichlet, Neumann and gliding boundary conditions.
